_doc: THE single source of truth for credit-pack pricing (T10210). Consumed by app/pricing.py (billing), src/frontend/src/config/pricing.js (app + landing site via the @editor alias). Packs must be listed in ascending price order with a strictly decreasing per-credit rate (the value ladder); tests enforce both. Stripe prices are created inline from price_cents, so a reprice here needs no Stripe dashboard work. Grants read pack metadata off the Stripe session/PI, not this file, so in-flight payments and historical rows are unaffected by a reprice. credits_per_play is NOT pricing: it is the measured all-in credits per exported play (render + its share of game upload/storage), used only for the approximate '~N plays' copy on pack cards. Measured 2026-10-29 from the prod credit ledger: 13.6 average over 291 exports by 52 users (render alone: 13.2s average, 11 median); re-measure when export habits shift.
